author: Nintendo of America
description:
It Takes Two arrives on Nintendo Switch 2! Play today: https://ninten.do/6001atuyP
 
Invite a friend to join the adventure in It Takes Two for free with Friend's Pass, even if they don’t own the game! Whether it’s splitting an ice cream sundae, grabbing a drink, spending the night on the couch, or going on the craziest adventure of your life, everything is better when you do it together. Also, flying through a mob of angry rodents in a plane made of underpants is 1000% more fun when you have a co-pilot. 
 
Friend’s Pass requires installation of the Friend’s Pass and applicable platform account. Online play requires a friend on the same platform. One user must own the full game in order for the co-op player to play the full game. 
 
#ItTakesTwo
